title: A by-reference array argument can later be replaced with a different element type

ground_truth.statement: sort modifies the array by reference but does not bind the variable permanently to strings. Replacing it with [0,1] returns exactly that integer list.

provenance.note: Replaced nondeterministic shuffle with deterministic sort, another by-reference mutator; retained string array then integer array reassignment.

notes: The return contract makes stale element-type inference observable.
